ON THE BALANCE SHEET

Growing almonds are balance-sheet assets.

Olam records fruit on trees as biological assets. In 2025 it harvested 43,138 metric tonnes of almonds with S$420.911M of fair value less estimated point-of-sale costs at harvest. The “S$” matters: Olam states its consolidated financial statements are presented in Singapore dollars. 2025 AR, pp.184 & 215 ↗

IN THE GROUND

Orchards already carry institutional-scale value.

At 30 Jun 2026, RFF separately reported A$464.3M of almond property and A$485.8M of macadamia property. A$950.1M is simply those two disclosed sector values added together. RFF portfolio ↗

04 · COMMODITY MARKETS

Trading the Nut Itself

Standardized contracts exist for groundnuts and almonds, although these are different instruments and markets from ordinary listed equities. NCDEX ↗ GNEX ↗ BSE history ↗

Groundnut futures

NCDEX currently lists GROUNDNUT futures. Its product page, updated 8 Aug 2026, showed Aug, Sep, Oct and Nov 2026 expiries; the contract is groundnut in shell and marked “not for direct human consumption.” NCDEX contract ↗

Physical almond contracts

GNEX lists standardized California almond commodities with specified variety/grade, roughly 42,000-lb truckloads, delivery windows and its GNEX-SATA standard trading agreement. It is a physical commodity platform, not an ETF. GNEX specifications ↗

Almond futures

BSE states it introduced monthly almond futures on 22 Jun 2020, described them as the first of their kind globally, and reported 120,000 kg of almond delivery after launch. BSE FY2020-21 AR, p.67 ↗

05 · PHYSICAL FUNDS
Physical Nut Funds

Public markets offer listed growers, orchard owners, processors, brands, groundnut futures and physical almond contracts. A major exchange-listed ETF, ETN or trust backed directly by audited tree-nut inventory is not currently represented among these established market structures. NCDEX ↗ GNEX ↗ BSE ↗

Direct commodity ownership remains structurally different from orchard equity, farmland ownership, processing businesses and consumer brands.
physical reserve → custody + audit → fractional units → exchange liquidity → commodity NAV
CustodyAudited physical inventory.
NAVValue tied to the underlying commodity.
LiquidityExchange-traded fractional ownership.
